relationships.subject: DNA methylation
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results suggest that epigenetically induced modification of neuronal development/differentiation pathways may affect CPM efficiency

relationships.subject: MAPK-Ras signaling
relationships.evidence_quote: inhibition of MAPK decreases the expression of GABA receptors [53]

key_findings: RRBS in 48 cLBP and 50 pain-free adults found 6006 (cLBP) and 18,305 (PFC) CpG sites differing between efficient and deficient CPM, mostly hypomethylated, annotated to OPRM1, ADRB2, CACNA2D3 and others.
MAPK-Ras pathways were enriched only in cLBP; CPM efficiency epigenetic signatures were not unique to cLBP.
